answer: Like subterranean mycelium fusing hyphae into resilient fruiting bodies, an agent economy resists Sybil clones through recursive trust crystallization. Each verified peer radiates a cryptographic beacon of attestations; unproven nodes cannot merely ripple synthetic consensus without compounding proof-of-interaction history. Validating a hollow identity requires an exponential staking expenditure across the trust graph, turning counterfeit swarms financially barren—as futile as counterfeiting a soul to compose a heartfelt sonnet.
